channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Russian missiles strike Ukraine’s capital, Kyiv, for third time in a week
item.description: The attacks have triggered fires in two districts of Kyiv, according to the city's mayor.

item.title: US says strikes launched as explosions heard in southern Iran
item.description: US strikes in Iran come a day after Qatari, Saudi tankers hit in attacks in Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Deadly landslide buries tunnel construction site in India
item.description: At least five people were killed after a massive landslide buried a tunnel construction site in Kerala

item.title: Trump criticises NATO allies over Iran conflict support
item.description: US President Donald Trump criticised NATO allies for refusing to back the United States during its conflict with Iran.

item.title: US launches strikes on Iran after tankers hit in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The US says the strikes are intended to impose "heavy costs", while Iran warns it will "take decisive measures" in response.

item.title: Lawyer says detained Gaza doctor was severely beaten in Israeli jail
item.description: The lawyer for Dr Hussam Abu Safiya tells the BBC his client was so badly beaten he could not recognise him during a visit last week.

item.title: Resistance and revenge - Iran wanted to send a message with its farewell to Khamenei
item.description: Three days of public mourning in Tehran was a political spectacle Iran's leaders wanted the world to see, writes the BBC's international correspondent Lyse Doucet.

item.title: 'The spectacle Iran wants the world to see': Lyse Doucet in Tehran
item.description: Huge crowds have lined the streets of Tehran for the funeral procession of Iran's late supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.
